# Rasengan.js

> Rasengan.js is a full-stack ecosystem for React: a Vite-based meta-framework (SSR/SSG/SPA, file-based & config-based routing, MDX) paired with Futon, a WinterCG-compatible HTTP runtime, and Rasengan Server, a NestJS-inspired backend framework built on Futon. Ships with agent skills for AI coding assistants.

## Rasengan — Getting Started

- [What's Rasengan.js?](https://rasengan.dev/docs/getting-started/introduction): Overview of the framework and its features
- [Installation](https://rasengan.dev/docs/getting-started/installation): Scaffold a project with `npx create-rasengan@latest`
- [Project Structure](https://rasengan.dev/docs/getting-started/project-structure): Default layout of a Rasengan.js project
- [Upgrading](https://rasengan.dev/docs/getting-started/upgrading): Upgrade to the latest (or a specific) version

## Rasengan — Routing

- [Base Concepts](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/base-concepts): How routing works in Rasengan.js
- [Router Configuration](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/router-configuration): Config-based routing with `defineRouter()`
- [Defining Routes](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/routes): Page components, layouts, and the `RouterComponent` class
- [Defining Layouts](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/layouts): Layout components for shared UI around pages
- [File-Based Routing](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/file-based-routing): Automatic routing via `src/app/_routes/`
- [Dynamic Routes](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/dynamic-routes): Dynamic segments `[param]`, optional `[_param]`, route groups `(group)`
- [Linking & Navigation](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/linking-and-navigation): Client-side navigation with `Link` and `NavLink`
- [Active Links](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/active-link): Style the active link in a navigation bar
- [Redirecting](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/redirecting): Define redirects in config or from loaders
- [Error Handling](https://rasengan.dev/docs/routing/error-handling): Error boundaries and 404 handling

## Rasengan — Rendering

- [SSR](https://rasengan.dev/docs/rendering/ssr): Server-side rendering with streaming
- [CSR](https://rasengan.dev/docs/rendering/csr): Client-side rendering (SPA mode, `ssr: false`)
- [Prerendering](https://rasengan.dev/docs/rendering/prerendering): Static site generation (SSG) with `prerender: true`

## Rasengan — API Reference

- [Link](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/components/link): Client-side navigation component

- [Template](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/components/template): HTML document shell (Head, Body, Script)

- [ScrollRestoration](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/components/scroll-restoration): Scroll position management per pathname
- [defineConfig](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/functions/define-config): Framework configuration function
- [defineRouter](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/functions/define-router): Config-based router definition
- [defineRoutesGroup](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/functions/define-routes-group): Group routes under a shared path prefix
- [defineStaticPaths](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/functions/define-static-paths): Generate SSG static paths for dynamic routes
- [renderApp](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/functions/render-app): Client entry point for hydration
- [Layout file convention](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/conventions/layout-component): `layout.tsx` naming
- [Page file convention](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/conventions/page-component): `*.page.tsx` naming
- [Router file convention](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/conventions/router-component): `app.router.ts` naming
- [create-rasengan CLI](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/create-rasengan-cli): Project scaffolding tool
- [rasengan CLI](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/rasengan-cli): `dev` and `build` commands
- [rasengan.config.js](https://rasengan.dev/docs/api-reference/rasengan-config): Full config file reference

## Futon — the HTTP runtime

`@rasenganjs/futon` is the zero-dependency, WinterCG-compatible HTTP middleware/router library underneath `@rasenganjs/server` — usable standalone on Node, Bun, or Workerd.

- [What's Futon?](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/getting-started/introduction): The WinterCG-compatible HTTP engine that powers Rasengan Server
- [Installation](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/getting-started/installation): Install `@rasenganjs/futon` and a runtime adapter
- [Quick Start](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/getting-started/quick-start): Build and run your first standalone Futon server
- [Context Object](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/context/overview): The `ctx` object every middleware and handler receives
- [Query Parameters](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/context/query-params): Read URL query params via `ctx.query`
- [Error Handling](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/error-handling): `HttpError` classes, `onError`, and `notFound` handlers
- [Hooks](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/hooks): Observe the request lifecycle without adding middleware
- [Built-in Middleware](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/middleware/built-in): CORS, logging, compression, auth, body parsing
- [Custom Middleware](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/middleware/custom): Write your own onion-model middleware
- [Request Utilities](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/request-response/request): Parse URLs and request bodies
- [Response Helpers](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/request-response/response): Response factories and the chainable `ResponseBuilder`
- [Cookies](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/request-response/cookies): Read and write cookies
- [Router](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/routing/router): Register routes, radix-tree dispatch
- [Route Patterns](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/routing/route-patterns): Static, dynamic, optional, wildcard segments
- [Route Groups](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/routing/route-groups): Scope a URL prefix and middleware with `router.group()`
- [fileUpload() Middleware](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/file-uploads/overview): Multer-style multipart file upload handling
- [Storage Engines](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/file-uploads/storage-engines): `MemoryStorage`, `DiskStorage`, and custom engines
- [Lazy Request (opt-in)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/performance/lazy-request): Defer `Request` construction on the Node hot path
- [Express Adapter](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/adapters/express): Mount a Futon app inside an existing Express app
- [Runtime Adapters](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/adapters/runtime): Node, Bun, and Workerd adapters via `@rasenganjs/runtime`
- [WinterCG Adapter](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/adapters/wintercg): Deploy to any WinterCG-compatible runtime
- [Futon (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/futon): The `Futon` app class reference
- [Router (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/router): The `Router` class reference
- [Context (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/context): `Context`, `createContext()`, and related types
- [Request (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/request): Request-parsing utilities
- [Response (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/response): `ResponseBuilder` and response factories
- [Middleware (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/middleware): The `Middleware` type and built-in factories
- [Hooks (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/hooks): `HookSystem`, `HookName`, `HookHandler`
- [Errors (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/errors): The `HttpError` class hierarchy
- [Upload (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/upload): `fileUpload()` and storage-engine types
- [Adapters (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/futon/api-reference/adapters): `toExpressHandler()`, `toWinterCgHandler()`, `FetchHandler`

## Rasengan Server — the backend framework

`@rasenganjs/server` is a modular, controller-based backend framework built on `@rasenganjs/futon`, plus its ecosystem packages (`@rasenganjs/ws`, `@rasenganjs/queue`, `@rasenganjs/validators`, `@rasenganjs/drizzle`).

- [What's Rasengan Server?](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/getting-started/introduction): A NestJS-inspired backend framework built on Futon
- [Installation](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/getting-started/installation): Install `@rasenganjs/server` and scaffold a project
- [Project Structure](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/getting-started/project-structure): How a typical project is organized
- [CLI](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/getting-started/cli): `rasengan-server dev`, `build`, `start`
- [Bootstrap & ServerApp](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/bootstrap): `bootstrap()` and the `ServerApp` orchestrator
- [Modules](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/modules): Group controllers, providers, and middleware with `defineModule()`
- [Controllers & Routing](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/controllers): Declaring routes with `Controller` and the schema-aware `Router`
- [Middleware](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/middleware): Global, module, controller, and route-level layering
- [Validation](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/validation): Schema-based request validation with Zod
- [WebSockets](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/websockets): Low-level `app.websocket()` routes
- [File Uploads](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/file-uploads): Multipart file uploads in a controller
- [Module Plugins](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/module-plugins): Extension point for ecosystem packages to add `defineModule()` fields
- [Config & Build](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/core-concepts/config-and-build): `rasengan.server.ts` options and build output
- [Providers & Tokens](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/dependency-injection/providers): Registering and resolving DI providers
- [Module Scoping](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/dependency-injection/scoping): Visibility between modules — imports, exports, globals
- [Lifecycle Hooks](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/dependency-injection/lifecycle): Provider `onInit`/`onDestroy` and eager resolution
- [Validation Adapters](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/ecosystem/validation-adapters): `@rasenganjs/validators` and adapting other schema libraries
- [WebSocket Gateways](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/ecosystem/websocket-gateways): NestJS-style Gateway classes from `@rasenganjs/ws`
- [Background Queues](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/ecosystem/queues): Background job processing with `@rasenganjs/queue`
- [Database (Drizzle)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/ecosystem/drizzle): Drizzle ORM via `DrizzleModule.forRoot()`
- [ServerApp (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/server-app): The `ServerApp` class reference
- [Controller (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/controller): The `Controller` abstract class and Router API
- [Provider (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/provider): The `Provider` abstract class
- [Container (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/container): The DI `Container`, `Provider`, `ProviderDefinition`
- [defineConfig (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/define-config): `RasenganServerConfig`, `BuildConfig`, `ConfigHolder`
- [defineModule (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/define-module): `defineModule()`, `ModuleConfig`, `ModulePlugin`
- [Logger (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/logger): `serverLogger()` and `serverLoggerMinimal()`
- [Upload (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/upload): File-upload types re-exported from Futon
- [WebSocket (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/websocket): `WebSocketRegistry` and runtime-agnostic types
- [CLI (API)](https://rasengan.dev/docs/server/api-reference/cli): Command and flag reference

## Agent Skills

Rasengan.js ships specialized skills for AI coding assistants (Claude Code and other compatible agents), covering all three frameworks. Install with `npx skills add rasengan-dev/agent-skills --all`, or individually with `npx skills add rasengan-dev/agent-skills@<skill-name>`.

- Repository: https://github.com/rasengan-dev/agent-skills
- Frontend (`rasengan-*`): pages, routing, config, data-fetching, styling, project-setup, optimizing, deployment, ecosystem
- Futon (`rasengan-futon-*`): core, routing, adapters
- Rasengan Server (`rasengan-server-*`): core, validation, websockets, queues, uploads, drizzle

## Quick Reference

### AppConfig (Rasengan)
```ts
interface AppConfig {
  ssr?: boolean;                                   // default: true
  prerender?: boolean | { routes: string[] };      // SSG mode
  sageMode?: { reactCompiler?: boolean | { compilationMode: 'annotation' } };
  server?: { development?: { port?: number; open?: boolean } };
  vite?: ViteConfig;                               // partial Vite overrides
  redirects?: () => Promise<Redirect[]>;            // static redirect rules
}
```

### RouterComponent properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `layout` | `LayoutComponent \| RouteNode` | Layout component for the router |
| `routers` | `RouterComponent[]` | Nested sub-routers |
| `pages` | `PageComponent[] \| RouteNode[]` | Page components |
| `loaderComponent` | `FunctionComponent` | Loading fallback |
| `notFoundComponent` | `FunctionComponent` | 404 component |
| `useParentLayout` | `boolean` | Inherit parent layout |

### Metadata
```ts
type Metadata = {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  openGraph?: { type?, title?, description?, url, image, width?, height? };
  twitter?: { card: 'summary_large_image'|'summary', image, title, description?, creator?, site? };
  links?: Array<{ rel, type?, sizes?, href }>;
  metaTags?: Array<{ name?, property?, content }>;
};
```

### File-based routing conventions
| File pattern | Route segment |
|-------------|---------------|
| `layout.tsx` | Layout for the route group |
| `*.page.tsx` / `*.page.mdx` | Page component |
| `[param].page.tsx` | Dynamic segment `:param` |
| `[_param].page.tsx` | Optional dynamic `:param?` |
| `(group)/` | Route group (ignored in path) |
| `_name/` | Optional static segment `name?` |

### Required project files (Rasengan)
- `rasengan.config.js` — Framework config using `defineConfig()`
- `src/main.{jsx,tsx}` — Root App component (default export, receives `AppProps`)
- `src/template.{jsx,tsx}` — HTML template (default export, receives `TemplateProps`)
- `src/app/app.router.{js,ts}` — Router definition (default export, `RouterComponent`)
- `src/index.{js,ts}` — Entry point calling `renderApp(App, AppRouter?)`
- `src/app/_routes/` — File-based route definitions (optional)

### Entry point pattern
```ts
import { renderApp } from 'rasengan/client';
import App from './main';

renderApp(App, AppRouter); // or renderApp(App) for config-based
renderApp(App, AppRouter, { reactStrictMode: true }); // with strict mode
```

### Router definition (config-based)
```ts
import { RouterComponent, defineRouter } from 'rasengan';
import Home from './home.page';

class AppRouter extends RouterComponent {}

export default defineRouter({
  pages: [Home],
  layout: AppLayout,
  notFoundComponent: NotFound,
})(AppRouter);
```

### Router definition (file-based)
```ts
import { RouterComponent, defineRouter } from 'rasengan';
import Router from 'virtual:rasengan/router';

class AppRouter extends RouterComponent {}

export default defineRouter({ imports: [Router] })(AppRouter);
```

### Page component
```ts
import { PageComponent } from 'rasengan';

const Home: PageComponent = () => <main>Home</main>;
Home.path = '/';
Home.metadata = { title: 'Home', description: 'Home page' };
export default Home;
```

### Layout component
```ts
import { Outlet, LayoutComponent } from 'rasengan';

const AppLayout: LayoutComponent = () => <div><Outlet /></div>;
AppLayout.path = '/';
export default AppLayout;
```

### CLI commands
```bash
rasengan dev            # Start development server (port 5320)
rasengan build          # Build for production
rasengan-serve ./dist   # Serve production build

rasengan-server dev     # Rasengan Server dev server
rasengan-server build   # Build Rasengan Server for production
rasengan-server start   # Start the production build
```

### Loader function (Rasengan)
```ts
import { LoaderFunction } from 'rasengan';

export const loader: LoaderFunction = async ({ params, request }) => {
  const data = await fetchData(params.id);
  return { props: { data }, meta: { title: 'Page Title' } };
};
```

### Futon app (standalone)
```ts
import { Futon } from '@rasenganjs/futon';
import { serve } from '@rasenganjs/runtime-node';

const app = new Futon();

app.get('/hello/:name', (ctx) => ctx.json({ message: `Hello ${ctx.params.name}` }));

serve(app, { port: 3000 });
```

### Rasengan Server controller
```ts
import { Controller } from '@rasenganjs/server';

export class UsersController extends Controller {
  routes() {
    this.router.get('/users', this.list);
  }

  list = (ctx) => ctx.json({ users: [] });
}
```

### Build output structure
```
dist/
  client/        # Client bundle + manifest.json
    assets/      # JS, CSS, config.json
    .vite/       # Vite manifest
  server/        # SSR server bundle
static/          # Pre-rendered HTML (SSG)
```

## Architecture

Rasengan.js is built on three pillars:
- **Vite** for fast development (HMR) and optimized builds
- **React Router v7** for client/server routing with loaders and actions
- **Express** for the dev and production SSR server

Rendering modes:
| Mode | Config | Description |
|------|--------|--------------|
| SSR | `ssr: true` (default) | Server renders HTML, client hydrates |
| SPA | `ssr: false` | Client-side only rendering |
| SSG | `prerender: true` | Pre-renders HTML at build time |

Futon and Rasengan Server share the same runtime-agnostic design (Node, Bun, Workerd, or any WinterCG-compatible host) and can be used standalone, outside of a Rasengan.js frontend project.
